audit: Generic critical-text lacuna boundary uncertainty helper
scope: Independent source-image review and helper/unit mechanics only. This does not certify integration, lexical adjudication, corpus completeness, or deployment.

source_evidence.citation: Campbell, Greek Lyric Poetry, Alcaeus 130b opening, printed page 57; PDF page 89
source_evidence.method: Visual inspection of supplied rendered crop
source_evidence.observation: Opening survivors are separated by spaced printed dot runs. The scan does not warrant treating every survivor beside a gap as a secure complete lexical item.

source_evidence.citation: Campbell, Greek Lyric Poetry, Alcaeus 130 commentary, printed page 296, note 16; PDF page 328
source_evidence.method: Visual inspection of supplied rendered crop
source_evidence.observation: Commentary explicitly presents the opening words as unrecoverable with confidence. It does not prove every adjacent survivor is incomplete or lexically invalid.

coverage: LF, CR, CRLF and Unicode line/paragraph separators
Comma, semicolon, Greek ano teleia, and zero-width separator barriers
Multiple independent gaps only affect nearest eligible neighbors
Two-sided evidence on a word between gaps
Deep-copy preservation of nested lexical candidates and input immutability

checks.check: Explicit opt-in requires source_critical is True
Full unchanged source offsets validated; selection edges do not conceal nearby source gaps
Literal Greek, partial-word status, editorial-fragment status, and lexical candidates remain unchanged
No form blacklist, author-specific exception, restoration, or invented dictionary content
intact_word_eligible excludes lacuna-boundary uncertainty without declaring lexical invalidity

limits: The helper recognizes runs of at least two ASCII dots separated by its declared horizontal-spacing set; it is not a universal critical-edition notation parser.
Caller source metadata must distinguish genuine printed loss conventions from prose ellipses. Being a critical edition alone does not prove every ellipsis is physical loss.
Consumer integration must preserve conditional literal lookup while withholding assured-intact coverage and definitive contextual adjudication for flagged tokens.
No corpus records, passage-analysis integration, dictionary content, or deployment state were changed by this review.
